Official parser fixtures, captured 2026-09-05. HTML is limited to the relevant content area; header navigation and assets are not included.

- `box_2024.html`: https://npb.jp/scores/2024/0329/s-d-01/box.html
- `box_2025.html`: https://npb.jp/scores/2025/0401/d-g-01/box.html
- `starters.html`: https://npb.jp/announcement/starter/ (announcements for September 6, 2026)

Player IDs, names, table headers, nested inning tables, batting totals and pitching rows are unchanged. Only indentation and trailing whitespace are normalized. Synthetic game histories in the unit tests are explicitly test data, not collected records.
